question: Can XTTS-v2 (clone voice) and the 20 fps MuseTalk avatar share the GPU in real time?

xtts_alone.conclusion: the cost is the autoregressive GPT, not the vocoder; fp16 autocast is slower

budget: per second of speech: XTTS 0.57 + MuseTalk 20/24 = 0.83 -> ~1.4 GPU-seconds; the processes time-slice the GPU, so the avatar falls behind the voice

live_result_xtts_plus_avatar.note: after fixing the worker crash; later chunks still waited for frames (32 waits > 1.5 s in 8 turns)

decision: avatar profile uses clone_light (Kokoro + OpenVoice V2 converter, RTF 0.05); XTTS stays for the voice-only clone profile
